en: A color postcard showing a striking modernist arena-like building with tall outward-leaning concrete supports and large glass panels. In the foreground there is a flowerbed full of red flowers and a parking area with several 1970s-era cars, some covered with tarps. In the upper right corner, there are postal cancellations printed over the image, one rectangular with Cyrillic text and a rocket illustration, and one circular postmark that reads "VARNA" and includes Cyrillic text and a date.
